name: Default
shortDescription: AI agent framework with an admin panel, REST and WebSocket API, plugin system and built-in vector memory for RAG over uploaded documents.

alerts.message: Open /admin and sign in with the default user admin / admin, then change the passwords of the default admin and user accounts in Settings > User Management.
The Cat needs an LLM: choose a provider and enter its API key (or the address of your own model server) in the admin Settings before it can answer.
